conventions.prior: theta ~ N(mu, sigma); sigma is inputs.sigma when a case has one, else the top-level sigma
conventions.log_posterior: sum_j log p(y_j | theta) + log N(theta; mu, sigma), all normalising constants included (gaussian terms include -log(sigma) - log(2 pi)/2)

map.step: candidates in order: Newton H = sigma^-1 + diag(observed information) if its Cholesky succeeds, then Fisher H = sigma^-1 + diag(expected information); step = H^-1 g; take the first candidate whose halving search passes; if none passes, stop without moving
map.halving_test: s = 1, 1/2, ... (at most max_halvings halvings) until lp(theta + s step) >= lp(theta) - lp_slack * (1 + |lp(theta)|)

expected_information.testlet: the marginal model's Fisher information over the 2^n response patterns (conventions.testlet.expected_information)

observed_information.3pl: y = 0: a^2 s (1 - s); y = 1: a^2 u (1 - s) (s (u + 2c) - c) / P^2, with s = logistic(a (theta - b)), u = (1 - c) s, P = c + u
observed_information.grm: a^2 (v_y + v_{y+1}) with v_j = s_j (1 - s_j), s_j = logistic(a (theta - b_j)) for j = 1..m, v_0 = v_{m+1} = 0
observed_information.testlet: E_pi[O] - Var_pi[S] (conventions.testlet.observed_information); >= 0 for the exact integral, >= -1e-9 for the grid rule with |a| * tau <= conventions.testlet.max_a_tau

map.stop: after an accepted step with max|s * step| < tol, or max_iter
map.n_iter: iterations run (1 when there are no observations); informational, not held to the tolerance

conventions.cov: inverse of (sigma^-1 + diag(total expected information at theta_map))

eap.weights: equal: w_i = exp(logpost_i - max_i logpost_i), normalised

conventions.nearest_pd: symmetrise; clip eigenvalues below floor up to floor (if min < floor - 1e-12); rescale to unit diagonal; if the min eigenvalue lam is still < floor - 1e-12, C = (1 - t) C + t I with t = (floor - lam) / (1 - lam)
conventions.observation_kind: per observation (the item's model), independent of the axis's default model: 3pl only for items with k <= 4 options, c = 1/k (ROADMAP A9); the scorer is axis-generic

testlet: items (1..max_items objects with exactly a, b, y)

testlet.model: the n (1..max_items) 2PL items of one passage / game setup share gamma ~ N(0, tau^2); given gamma they are independent 2PL items on theta + gamma. The block is one likelihood term on its axis: L(theta) = integral of prod_j p_j(y_j | theta + gamma) N(gamma; 0, tau^2) dgamma, p_j(1 | t) = logistic(a_j (t - b_j))

grid.nodes: z_i = -z_max + i * z_step, i = 0..n_nodes - 1 (z = 0 is a node)
grid.rule: L(theta) = sum_i w_i prod_j p_j(y_j | theta + gamma_i)

testlet.loglik: log L(theta), by log-sum-exp over the nodes
testlet.score: d log L / d theta = sum_i pi_i S_i, with pi_i = w_i L_i / sum_k w_k L_k, L_i = prod_j p_j(y_j | theta + gamma_i), S_i = sum_j a_j (y_j - p_ij)
testlet.observed_information: -d^2 log L / d theta^2 = sum_i pi_i O_i - (sum_i pi_i S_i^2 - (sum_i pi_i S_i)^2), O_i = sum_j a_j^2 p_ij (1 - p_ij)
testlet.expected_information: sum over the 2^n response patterns y of P(y) score(y)^2 = sum_y (sum_i w_i L_i(y) S_i(y))^2 / P(y), P(y) = sum_i w_i L_i(y); patterns with P(y) = 0 contribute 0
testlet.accuracy: the grid rule is the model. Against the exact integral its error in log L is below 1e-6 wherever log L >= -20 for |a| * tau <= max_a_tau (|a| <= 10 at tau = 0.3), and grows with |a| * tau and with how improbable the pattern is; an item with |a| * tau > max_a_tau is rejected

terms.where: top-level testlet_terms: each vector gives the four functions at its thetas

testlet.usage: the items a session answered from one passage / setup form ONE testlet observation; items of different passages, and plain 2pl items, are separate independent terms; the MAP, Laplace covariance, EAP and log posterior treat a testlet like any other observation term of its axis
